name: For The Love Of Alex
region_note: HELP PAYING VET BILLS - funds and lists from the Mayor's Alliance vet care page, checked 2026-11-03. Most have eligibility rules; read them before applying.
notes: Helps pay for urgent veterinary care for cats and dogs only, paying the vet or pharmacy directly. One pet per household; proof of income is needed. It does not pay for vaccinations, spay/neuter, cancer treatment (chemotherapy or radiation) or routine care. Start with the short pre-application on its Help My Pet page. A small charity in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania, so it cannot take every case.
